messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike on /v1/live/sse (eu-prod). p99 -> 4.2s (baseline 0.6s). SLO alert page triggered. Auto-run diagnostics started. :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Metrics summary: p95=1.1s p99=4.2s error-rate 0.8% streaming dropped-chunks +300% last 10m. Top route: /v1/live/sse (session-preserve).

anna_oncall: I'm on it. Starting triage — can someone confirm customer impact? Any CS tickets?

raj_cs: multiple customers reported stalled feeds (one mentions updates arriving 30-60s late). No severity 1 customer, but two major accounts seeing noticeable degradation.

maria_platform: looking at proxy logs (eu-edge-proxy). Seeing many slow writes + ECONNRESET to backend. Nginx proxy_buffering toggled on for streams recently in canary. Could be interaction with client backpressure.

jim_sre: +1. Also seeing long tail on server workers: KV cache eviction spikes and some worker p95 memory GC pauses. Attaching sample logs:

```
[eu-proxy-03] 2026-02-14T18:02:12Z upstream write timeout: 30s -> downstream closed
[model-srv-7] 2026-02-14T18:02:12Z chunk-send: client_write EAGAIN after 7s
[model-srv-7] 2026-02-14T18:02:13Z sv_latency p95=1.2s p99=3.9s
```

anna_oncall: Ok. Immediate mitigations: 1) set nginx proxy_read_timeout=90s for /v1/live/sse 2) disable proxy_buffering for that location 3) increase model-srv replica count by +2 in eu cluster. Who can run these?

maria_platform: I can flip the nginx settings in the edge canary and then roll to eu. Suggest applying to canary:

```
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/edge-proxy PROXY_READ_TIMEOUT=90
kubectl -n infra patch configmap/edge-nginx --type merge -p '{"data":{"sse_proxy_buffering":"off"}}'
```

jim_sre: I'll scale the deployment:

```
kubectl -n prod scale deployment/model-worker --replicas=8 -l region=eu
```

anna_oncall: Maria, please verify logs after canary. Jim, after scaling, watch worker CPU/memory p95 and tail latency. Raj, keep CS updated with a short note: "We see streaming stalls; engineering is mitigating; we expect improved latency in ~10-15m".

maria_platform: Canary change applied to eu-canary edge. Observing immediate drop in proxy write timeouts (from 18/min -> 2/min). Rolling to eu-prod now with a 2m pause between pods.

deploy-bot: rollout started: edge-proxy (eu) -> 12 pods updated, strategy=rolling

jim_sre: model-worker scaled. Backend queue depth dropped ~40%. p95 backend latency improved to ~0.9s in last 3m.

anna_oncall: Nice. Early numbers: p95=0.9s p99=1.4s for SSE endpoint. Error-rate dropping. Customer reports still trickling in but fewer stall complaints.

raj_cs: pinged affected customers with the mitigation note — a few acknowledged, one wants replay data; CS will collect logs for that account.

maria_platform: Follow-ups: we should revert proxy_buffering toggle if it causes other regressions, and add an automation: detect repeated EAGAIN from writes and auto-shed heavy connections to preserve tailroom. Filing infra ticket.

jim_sre: Also capturing flamegraphs of model-srv worker during next p99 to validate if GC/heap churn caused earlier stalls.

anna_oncall: Handoff to night oncall in 30m. Summary for handoff: cause suspected interaction between proxy_buffering + slow client writes causing upstream backpressure; immediate fixes: disabled buffering, increased proxy_read_timeout, scaled model-worker replicas. Current status: p95/p99 near baseline, error-rate normalizing. Next actions: infra to add safeguard for streaming endpoints, SRE to validate no regressed memory GC.

incident-bot: Incident classified: mitigated (monitoring). Will auto-close alert if p99 < 1.5s for 30m.

anna_oncall: Thanks team. @maria_platform @jim_sre please paste ticket links and one-line RCA in this thread before handoff. I'll do final note for customers. :white_check_mark:
